Design a candidate against vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus (VRE). Primary target: VanA (PDB 1IOG). Target rationale: D-Ala:D-Lac ligase replaces D-Ala:D-Ala; vancomycin loses one of five H-bonds, ~1000x affinity drop. Run the standard panel and end with a structured FINAL CANDIDATE REPORT.

[Designer]: Anchor on the re-engineered glycopeptide (vancomycin-aglycone). removes the H-bond clash with D-Lac. Keeping the pharmacophore but extending the allosteric tail. Two design vectors against VanA (vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus, PDB 1IOG): (a) optimize the catalytic-pocket fit, (b) widen contacts to escape variants vanA acquired, vanB acquired.

Design a candidate against Pseudomonas aeruginosa (Paer). Primary target: PBP3 (PDB 3OG7). Target rationale: essential transpeptidase; ceftolozane modified side chain escapes MexAB-OprM efflux. Run the standard panel and end with a structured FINAL CANDIDATE REPORT.

[Designer]: Anchor on the ceftolozane-class (modified side chain to escape MexAB). bulky polar tail prevents MexB recognition. Keeping the pharmacophore but adding a methyl ortho to the H-bond donor. Two design vectors against PBP3 (Pseudomonas aeruginosa, PDB 3OG7): (a) optimize the catalytic-pocket fit, (b) widen contacts to escape variants AmpC-derepressed, MexAB-OprM-up.
